For each entry in the vector walker+0x60..+0x68: elem = [entry+0x10], parent = elem+0x1a0; if the parent has +0x198 bit 0x20 and exactly one child, the parent is removed instead. Calls 0x144169990(walker, elem) and elem vt+0x30, erases elem from the parent child vector ([parent+0x178]+8..+0x10; error code 2 traced if absent), clears elem+0x1a0, sets +0x199 bit 4 and [elem+0x1a8]+8 bit 0x10, marks the parent with Ui_Mark_ElementAndAncestors_Flag170 and ancestors +0x170 bit 0x1000000, then looks up the element factory by type id (vt+0x18; 'eText' special-cased) in the UI system registry under lock and calls factory vt+0x10(elem). Finally resets +0x68 = +0x60. Context from caller: Ui_EngineModule_Update runs it once per frame just before Ui_LayoutTrees_WalkAll(walker). Hook point for element destruction.
